decision.reason: The in-sample candidate reaches 44/50 exact source-video set counts and 41/50 strict boundary-exact source videos. It does not meet the requested 50/50 replay goal or an independent held-out promotion gate.

poseBackend.name: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker Heavy
poseBackend.role: Produces raw frame observations and visibility; it does not count repetitions.

canonicalRuntime.name: MaxPower Rust Motion SDK
canonicalRuntime.role: Locks the subject, rejects outliers, fuses kinematically valid weak arm observations, predicts short gaps, preserves unknown joints, and seals repetitions.

recognitionFramework.profileRole: Selects exact-context kinematic signals, direction, amplitude, hysteresis, gap and duration gates for the ready-effort-peak-return state machine. It does not generate skeleton coordinates or classify arbitrary actions.

poseDriftDiagnosis.rootCause: Large visual jumps begin in raw MediaPipe observations under supine perspective, occlusion, out-of-frame body parts and body-adjacent limbs. Rust landmark ordering is not corrupted.

benchSpotCheck.interpretation: Bone-constrained fusion recovers some usable joints but not a complete, separable cycle signal.

reviewFrameSpotCheck.finding: The raw elbow visibility is below 0.5. Rust marks the corresponding short-gap result predicted rather than accepting the raw jump as measured.

alternativePoseExperiment.result: The inspected rear single-arm frame still produced incorrect elbow topology; a tight crop reduced score further. This model is not currently a verified replacement.

weakFusionExperiment.result: Low-gain fusion improves landmark availability. Raising the gain worsened full-video replay and was reverted.
weakFusionExperiment.conclusion: Long-lived weak coordinates cannot safely be treated as reliable measurements merely because RGB is human-readable.

implemented: Bone-length-constrained weak elbow and wrist fusion
Timestamp-based velocity prediction for gaps no longer than 150 ms
predictionPolicy.unsafe: Unbounded multi-second extrapolation would hallucinate a plausible skeleton, hide model failure and create false repetitions.
predictionPolicy.nextAlgorithm: A separately authorized masked temporal estimator may use action context, bone constraints, velocity, acceleration and prior-repetition phase, but must publish uncertainty and retain an unknown/reacquisition path.

personalCorpus.interpretation: All personal metrics are in-sample golden replay diagnostics, not unseen-user accuracy.

personalReplay.strictDefinition: A source passes strict replay only when the summed predicted count equals summed expected count and every available human boundary across all context windows is matched.
